name: Loki
source:
The character wakes up in an abandoned house with amnesia. The atmosphere is eerie, you never leave the feeling that something terrible has happened. You need to collect clues, uncover the secrets of the house and your own past to find out the truth.

[From [url=https://echolran.itch.io/the-locks]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
角色在一座废弃的房子里醒来，并患有失忆症。气氛很诡异，你永远不会感觉发生了可怕的事情。你需要收集线索，揭开房子的秘密和你自己的过去，以找出真相。

[来自[url=https://echolran.itch.io/the-locks]Itch.io[/url]]
